ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial regions (approx. horizontal 20% to 80%) are dominated by contiguous low-intensity black pigmentation. High-intensity white pigmentation is localized to distal lateral regions; the left distal region contains ~6 discrete dark focal spots, while the right distal region shows larger, irregular dark mottling and clusters of dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees; notch depth corresponds to approximately 15% of the total vertical extent of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly serrated trailing edge along both lobes; peaks and valleys occur at a frequency of approximately 1 per 12-15 horizontal pixels, with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 6 pixels. Serrations appear more pronounced and irregular on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a consistent concave mathematical curve from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, characterized by high-relief textured protrusions and shadowing consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe's dark pigmentation, including three prominent parallel vertical scratches and several smaller horizontal/diagonal abrasions in the central field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distal to the median notch, suggesting a site of physical trauma or amputation; extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
